sentences.text:
Appellant
 Through: Mr. Abhishek Singh, Advocate.

Respondent
 Through: Mr. M.S. Gupta & Ms. Niharika
 Jauhari, Advocates.

Coram:
 Justice Prathiba M. Singh
 Order
% 22.07.2021
1.
This hearing has been done through video conferencing.
2. Let a reply be filed within two weeks as the last and final opportunity.
Rejoinder, thereto, be filed within two weeks thereafter.

3. List on 16th September, 2021 along with the other matters arising out of the same statute i.e. the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
4.
Mr. Abhishek Singh, ld. Counsel submits that the matters have to be dealt with individually.
Considering that they all arise from the same statute, they are listed on the same date however, the Court would consider if they are to be adjudicated individually.
